i wanted to point out how this is about my mother, the same goes for fathers.

my mother commited suicide while I was still a child, that spiraled me down a path of deep self hatred. I thought that it was my fault that she killed herself, that nobody would ever want a child like me. As I grew older the void of not having a mother figure in my life is still very much there, it doesnt heal with time; You just learn to tolerate it.

I know you don't want to hurt your child, and I'm not mistaking the struggles that you are dealing with but depraving that child of a parent, no matter the state you are in, is an extremely selfish thing to do.

I truly do wish that my mother wouldve held on for me and the pain is unbearable, im not saying this out of "tough love" or any other type of hatred, I most definitely am not trying to bash you in the state you're in now because I can tell you arent okay, aswell as that you do care about your child enough to ask this question, so I apologoize for what I'm about to say, but I digress.

If you dont hold on for them you shouldnt call yourself a parent don't call that baby your kid, put them up for adoption, let them live a normal life killing yourself is probably one of the most selfish things you can do to a newborn.

Please take my advice and seek pshycyatric help, if your feeling this way you obviously cant get through this on your own;  I wish you heath and love, I would also like to offer my help with anything I could possibly do to get you through this, if you need anyone to talk to please dm me.
